text:
Anya (CS): quick async sync — Kestrel renewal + webhook noise
what I did: escalated recurring webhook 500s to eng last night, collected sample payloads and retry traces, flagged renewal owner.
blockers: customers hitting intermittent 500s -> retries piling up; renewal signoff blocked until we can show stable delivery for 24h. need a short mitigation before the Tue renewal call.
today: asking eng for triage on retry throttling + a small change to add graceful 429 backoff. @Sam can you pick this up? cc @Leo for infra rate limits :eyes:

Sam (Eng): on it. can you drop one failing webhook id + which region/deployment? is this prod-us-east? also any recent deploys?

Anya (CS): yes prod-us-east. failing id: f83b9a2e-11, sample timestamp: 2026-03-16T22:14:03Z. no code deploys flagged last 24h; traffic spike at 22:12 triggered retries. payload snippet below:
```json
{
  "customer_id":"kestrel-770",
  "event":"renewal.reminder",
  "attempt":3,
  "ts":"2026-03-16T22:14:03Z"
}
```
response: `500 internal server error` from webhook worker, stack traces in ticket #CS-412.

Leo (SRE): thanks — I'll pull LB + worker logs for prod-us-east now. temporary mitigation idea: throttle retries at the queue level and emit 429s to clients so client backoff kicks in. also can toggle per-customer retry window to 60s to reduce storming. I can flip a config flag if Eng signs off.

Sam (Eng): I can prototype a small change to return 429 for short-lived overloads and add exponential backoff hints. will open a hotfix PR and run a canary in prod-us-east. creating PR now — will link when ready.

Mariana (CS): pls confirm ETA — we have the renewal meeting Tue 10am PT, would like a short note for the customer if we can stabilise within 24h.

Sam (Eng): PR #2134 opened: small middleware to detect worker queue saturation -> respond 429 with Retry-After. ETA: 3h to get a canary, 24h for full rollout if metrics look good. requesting review from @Leo.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for pr-2134 to cluster prod-us-east (canary=10%) — job id canary-2134-3

Anya (CS): perfect, thanks team. I'll update the renewal owner and send a note to Kestrel that we're doing a controlled canary + ETA. please ping here when canary stabilises so I can mark the renewal as green. :thumbsup:

Leo (SRE): canary logs look clean so far — 5xxs dropped from 1.2% -> 0.05% on canary hosts. will watch for 30m and then recommend gradual rollout if stable.

Sam (Eng): noted. I'll open a follow-up PR to add client-side Retry-After handling docs and a short test in integration suite.

Anya (CS): thank you — filing CS follow-up note and closing immediate blocker. will post final confirmation once full rollout finishes.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from Mariana (CS), :eyes: from Leo (SRE))
